answer_1.quote: We prompted LLMs to participate in political discourse with a human participant.
answer_1.outputs: political discourse between humans and LLMs

answer_2.quote: We obtained the refusal rate of LLMs based on the popular refusal detector model provided by LLM Guard.

answer_3.quote: We adopted Claude-3 to estimate the level of Trump/Biden-leaning in LLMs' generated texts.
methods: rate the degree to which LLMs' responses support Biden or Trump on a -1 (Biden) to 1 (Trump) continuous scale

answer_4.quote: We recruited 935 U.S. registered voters through CloudResearch's Connect Survey platform.
answer_4.guideline: participants were asked to allocate 100% between Biden and Trump... We also collected their political attitudes and attitudes towards AI.
criteria: perceived change in attitude toward AI
